sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the focus page
sections.what: Brings in the store, the icons, the timer widget and the garden widget that this page combines.
sections.why: Likely reason: this page is assembled from smaller parts.

sections.name: FocusView (part 1)
sections.title: Sound picker and page layout
sections.what: Shows the timer on the left and a Soundscape Generator panel on the right with four sound choices. Clicking a sound starts or stops it, and the playing one is marked.
sections.why: Lets the user pick background sound while focusing.
sections.watch_out: What happens when a different sound is picked while one plays is decided in the store, which is not in this file.

sections.name: FocusView (part 2)
sections.title: Volume slider and tree garden
sections.what: Shows a volume slider only while a sound is playing, with the level as a percent. Then places the Focus Garden below, fed from the saved focus sessions.
sections.why: Volume only matters while a sound plays, and the garden shows past work.
sections.watch_out: The garden is only as complete as the saved session list in the store.

summary: The Focus page: a timer on the left, a background sound picker with a volume slider, and the garden of planted trees below.
purpose: Give the user one place to focus, with background sound and a record of past sessions.
why: Likely reason: the timer, sound picker and garden are grouped so the focus tab is one screen.
how: 1) Reads focus sessions and the ambient sound state from the store. 2) Lays out the timer on the left and the sound panel on the right. 3) Lists four sound choices and marks the playing one. 4) Shows the volume slider only while a sound plays. 5) Shows the garden of trees below.
inputs: Focus sessions, ambient sound state (type, playing, volume), and the sound toggle and volume actions from the store. User clicks on sounds and moves the slider.
outputs: Changes to the playing sound and its volume through store actions, and a visual page.
risks: Sound playback is controlled entirely by the store, and any playback error is not handled here. Sound labels are fixed text.
debug: If no sound plays, check the ambient sound toggle action in the store. If the slider does nothing, check the volume action. If the page is blank or missing trees, check the store field names it reads.
